title: OWASP Internet of Things Top 10
summary: Core vulnerability taxonomy focusing on weak passwords, insecure ecosystem interfaces, unencrypted network services, and lack of secure update mechanisms.

title: ETSI EN 303 645: Cyber Security for Consumer Internet of Things
summary: Baseline European standard defining 13 cybersecurity outcome-focused provisions for consumer connected devices.

title: NIST SP 800-213: IoT Device Cybersecurity Guidance for the Federal Government
summary: Guidance on integrating IoT devices into existing enterprise network security architectures, device identity, and logical access control.

title: NIST IR 8259A: IoT Device Cybersecurity Capability Core Baseline
summary: Defines foundational device capabilities: device identification, configuration, data protection, interface access, software updates, and cybersecurity event logging.

title: ENISA Baseline Security Recommendations for IoT in the context of Critical Information Infrastructures
summary: Outlines threat models, attack vectors, and baseline security measures across the IoT hardware, network, and service lifecycle.

title: CISA Alert TA16-288A: Heightened Adversary Interest in Insecure IoT Devices (Mirai Botnet Analysis)
summary: Technical advisory dissecting automated Telnet/SSH credential scanning and botnet propagation vectors used by Mirai-derived malware.

title: MITRE ATT&CK: Network Denial of Service (T0814 / T1498)
summary: Adversary tactics and volumetric flow patterns executing direct network floods (SYN flood, UDP amplification) against target endpoints via compromised nodes.

title: MITRE ATT&CK: Brute Force: Password Guessing (T1110.001)
summary: Technique analysis of automated dictionary and credential spraying attacks targeting weak default management interfaces on IoT devices.

title: MITRE ATT&CK: Network Service Discovery (T1046)
summary: Methods by which adversaries scan local and public IP spaces to identify listening services, open ports, and vulnerable daemon versions.

title: MITRE ATT&CK: Exploitation of Remote Services (T1210)
summary: Exploitation techniques leveraging unauthenticated remote buffer overflows, command injection, and logic flaws in embedded network daemons.

title: Cloud Security Alliance (CSA): IoT Security Controls Framework v2
summary: Comprehensive set of matrix controls designed to harden connected devices and their supporting cloud telemetry pipelines.

title: ISO/IEC 27400:2022 Guidelines for IoT Security and Privacy
license: Open Access Overview / Fair Use Documentation
summary: International guidelines addressing security controls, trust boundaries, and privacy protections across distributed IoT architectures.

title: RFC 8576: Internet of Things (IoT) Security: State of the Art and Challenges
summary: IETF overview of IoT communication security vulnerabilities, transport constraints, and mitigation tradeoffs.

title: RFC 8520: Manufacturer Usage Descriptions (MUD) Specification
summary: Standard for defining device intent profiles, enabling switches and firewalls to automatically isolate IoT devices into strict network access policies.

title: OASIS MQTT Security Best Practices Specification
summary: Guidelines for securing publish/subscribe message brokers via mutual TLS, authenticated topic authorization, and payload integrity.

title: RFC 7252: Constrained Application Protocol (CoAP) Security Considerations
summary: Examines UDP amplification vectors, resource exhaustion, and DTLS binding requirements for constrained embedded endpoints.

title: CISA Alert AA20-302A: Ransomware and Botnet Activity Exploiting End-of-Life Consumer Routers
summary: Advisory detailing adversary weaponization of unpatched firmware vulnerabilities in edge routing devices for command-and-control persistence.

title: The Mozi IoT Botnet: Analysis of P2P Command and Control Architecture
summary: Deconstruction of peer-to-peer Distributed Hash Table (DHT) mechanisms used by the Mozi malware family to coordinate DDoS and exfiltration.

title: UPnP Vulnerabilities: CallStranger (CVE-2020-12695) Advisory
summary: Analysis of Universal Plug and Play SUBSCRIBE header callback flaws used to bypass firewalls and conduct DDoS amplification.

title: Bluetooth Core Specification: Low Energy (BLE) Security Modes and Pairing Profiles
summary: Technical reference detailing BLE cryptographic key generation, LE Secure Connections, and eavesdropping/Man-in-the-Middle mitigation.

title: Zigbee Alliance Security Baseline Specification for Connected Home
summary: Network-layer encryption, frame counter anti-replay safeguards, and secure over-the-air commissioning standards for IEEE 802.15.4 mesh nodes.

title: NIST IR 8259B: IoT Non-Technical Supporting Capabilities
summary: Requirements for vulnerability disclosure handling, transparent firmware update supply chain policies, and customer documentation.

title: NIST SP 800-160 Vol. 2: Developing Cyber-Resilient Systems
summary: Architectural principles for damage containment, automated fail-safe operation, and rapid service restoration in connected environments.

title: Gafgyt / BASHLITE Malware Family Behavioral Profile
summary: Deconstruction of high-volume TCP/UDP flood payloads, Telnet scanning routines, and remote shell execution methods on Linux-based IoT architectures.

title: ENISA Good Practices for Security of IoT: Smart Homes
summary: Comprehensive security controls spanning isolation of management VLANs, hardware secure boot validation, and user interface tokenization.
